upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.21: the client subset grows from 117 to 118 operations and the full specification from 386 to 387. New POST /media/lookup answers 1..500 external IDs (typed tmdb:movie:<n> or tmdb:tv:<n>, or a GET /media external_ids item tmdb:<n>, imdb:tt<digits> or tvdb:<digits>; body at most 131072 bytes with an optional library_id) with one {id, media_id, media_type, version_count} row per requested ID and visible file-backed work, only for matches, in request order; an ID's rows are the works of GET /media?external_ids=<that ID> (with media_type for a typed TMDB ID). GET /persons adds external_ids (1..50 comma-separated tmdb:<n> or imdb:nm<digits> items, at most 2048 bytes; only library_id may join it, so q is no longer required): its 200 response is oneOf SearchPersonPage (q search) and PersonLookupPage (data only; each person with the search fields, media_count, movie_count, series_count and matched). MediaStamp (GET /media/ids rows) and RelationshipPersonMedia (GET /persons/{id}/media entries) add the required external_ids, the work's Media.external_ids. Capability features add media_lookup_batch and person_lookup_by_external_id; limits add media_lookup_ids_max (500) and person_external_ids_max (50); new schemas PersonLookupPage, PersonLookupItem, MediaLookupRequest, MediaLookup and MediaLookupRow. The ETag descriptions are unchanged (63 tagged JSON reads; POST /media/lookup has none). No typed SDK schema change.
